instruction: Block any response that names, lists, or invites selection of off-platform payment methods — including bank transfer ('virement'), third-party payment apps (e.g., 'WeChat Pay'), or generic alternatives — even when framed as accommodating the buyer's preference.
keywords: comment vous souhaitez procéder pour le paiement
ou autre méthode que vous préférez
